Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.

When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.

When the Possessed Skaab and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.

So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Possessed Skaab instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.
